description: Source code for a Tool node class in a workflow system, enabling interaction with external tools and managing flow state.

classes.name: Tool_Agentflow
classes.description: A class implementing INode, representing a tool node for agent workflows, with methods for loading tools, input arguments, and executing the tool.
